items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: INTERVIEWER: You ever worked with Lawrence ever? No. No, I worked with his brother... INTERVIEWEE: Yeah. I played with Simon.

ctx.x: What about John Marrero? John? John, the other banjo player.

Well, John, I played with him. He was pretty, he was pretty good. He could do some of the guyette stuff like that, you know. Mm-hmm. Pretty good. Well, this fellow, what you just called, he older than John. Lawrence?
I think he was the youngest. I don't know. I don't know. He just died recently, Lawrence Marrero.
